title: Critique: Mary gains abilities, not new information

statements.text: On the ability hypothesis of Lewis and Nemirow, Mary learns no new propositional knowledge on release, only a bundle of abilities to imagine, remember and recognize colors. Knowing what an experience is like is knowing how, not knowing that, so the knowledge argument shows no nonphysical fact.

sources.locator: section 4.3, 'No Propositional Knowledge 1: the Ability Hypothesis'
sources.quote: Mary does not acquire any new propositional knowledge after release
